# Preview Sample Rate<AvailableFrom v="4.0.470" />

Controls the sample rate used for audio playback during preview. When unset, Remotion uses `48000` Hz.

## CLI flag

```text
--preview-sample-rate <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setPreviewSampleRate(44100);
```
